query: Which convergence diagnostics and thresholds (ESS, ΔP, burn-in rules) will be enforced for joint-sampling, and how will uncertainty envelopes be summarized and visualized for non-technical stakeholders?

response.query: Which convergence diagnostics and thresholds (ESS, ΔP, burn-in rules) will be enforced for joint-sampling, and how will uncertainty envelopes be summarized and visualized for non-technical stakeholders?
response.answer: For joint-sampling, ESS > 1000 and ΔP < 0.01 are enforced. Burn-in rules set initial samples to discard. Uncertainty envelopes are summarized as mean ± SD and visualized via error bars on graphs for stakeholders.
